svg.title: Feature values and contributions
svg.desc: football-csv | PL | fixed output H - A | 32 holdout rows 2026-03-21 to 2026-04-25 | model 248ab51bf6b5 | run 3c493184a1e17c956bc9 The two features with highest mean absolute contribution are displayed. Each point is one observed row. This is an association display, not partial dependence, a causal response or a feature interaction test.
